name: A rise from nothing
about: A young commoner, a swineherd or a potboy, catches a lord's eye, fights, gets knighted and wins land of their own. Or a jealous bannerman or the first battle cuts them down.
title: The Rise of {upstart}

create.memory: I was born in the stables at {patron.seat}, and I mean to die in a hall.

goal.text: hold land of my own, even though I was born with none

fade: {upstart} keeps serving, a good sword in a crowded hall, and nobody sings about {upstart.him}.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: At the spring muster at {patron.seat}, a {upstart.born} called {upstart} knocks a knight off his horse with a borrowed lance. {patron} asks the {upstart.man}'s name.

memory.patron: A {upstart.born} called {upstart} knocked a knight off his horse at my muster.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: {patron} laughs and tosses the {upstart.man} a coin for the show. {upstart} keeps the coin, but leaves {patron.seat} on foot before dawn.

memory.upstart: {patron} threw me a coin like I was a juggler. I left {patron.seat} on foot.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: {patron} takes {upstart} into {patron.his} household as a squire. The other squires put dung in {upstart.his} boots, but only once.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: Raiders come over the hills near {patron.seat}. {upstart} holds a ford with six men until {patron}'s riders arrive.

memory.patron: {upstart} held the ford when grown knights ran. I owe that {upstart.man} my lands.

die.how: I died holding the ford for {patron}.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: {upstart} rides in the tournament at {patron.seat} in borrowed armour and stays in the saddle all day.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: {upstart} is knocked off in the last run and laughed out of the tournament. {upstart.He} goes back to the stables, and the horses don't laugh.

memory.upstart: They laughed me out of the tournament at {patron.seat}. I went back to the horses.

beats.speaker: patron
beats.text: {patron} knights {upstart} in the hall at {patron.seat}. {upstart.He} kneels a {upstart.born} and gets up as {upstart.Sir} {upstart.first}.

memory.upstart: {patron} knighted me in the hall at {patron.seat}. I knelt in straw and got up a knight.
memory.rival: {patron} knighted a {upstart.born}. What's a knighthood worth now?

beats.speaker: rival
beats.text: At dinner {rival} says a {upstart.born} in a knight's cloak still smells of the cowshed. {upstart} answers with a fist.

memory.rival: {upstart} hit me at {patron}'s table, in front of everyone. A {upstart.born} hit me.
memory.upstart: {rival} humiliated me at dinner. I hit {rival.him}, and I'd do it again.

beats.text: {upstart} falls sick after a feast at {patron.seat}. The cup came from {rival}'s end of the table.

die.how: I drank from a cup at {patron}'s feast and never got up.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: {upstart} lives, but thinner and quieter. {patron} sends {rival} home to {rival.seat} and doesn't invite {rival.him} again.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: {rival} demands a duel, and they fight at dawn on the green below {patron.seat}.

die.how: A {upstart.born} killed me on the green at {patron.seat}.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: {upstart} walks off the green with {rival}'s blood on {upstart.his} sword, and all of {patron.seat} saw it.
{rival} runs {upstart} through on the green below {patron.seat}. The {upstart.born}'s knighthood lasted one summer.

die.how: {rival} killed me on the green at dawn.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: {patron} makes {upstart} lord of {grant}. A {upstart.man} born in straw now has a hall under {upstart.his} own banner.

memory.upstart: I hold {grant}. I was born in the stables at {patron.seat}, and now I hold {grant}.
memory.patron: I gave {grant} to {upstart}, who was born in my stables.

upstart.text: repay {patron}, who raised me up from the straw

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: There's no land to give, but {upstart} rides at {patron}'s right hand now, and men who used to kick {upstart.him} call {upstart.him} {upstart.sir}.
{upstart} is buried at {patron.seat}, under a stone {patron} pays for. The stable hands visit the grave without being told to.

memory.patron: I buried {upstart}, who was born in my stables and died my knight.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: {patron} dies, and every promise made to {upstart} dies with {patron.him}. The new lord of {patron.seat} has squires of {patron.his} own.
